question_text: The Government Internship Program (GIP) is a flagship initiative of the Civil Service Commission (CSC) that aims to provide young Filipinos with opportunities to gain practical experience in the public sector. Through the GIP, interns are assigned to various government agencies where they assist in administrative tasks, project implementation, and policy research. The program also includes mentorship from seasoned civil servants and training sessions on ethical governance. Since its launch, the GIP has helped thousands of graduates develop skills that make them more competitive for future employment in government or the private sector. What is the main idea of this passage?
